policy: The second October 15 pass deleted screens, state variants and status components whose only purpose was to show a backend or contract state or to restate an invariant as a screen (cancellation races, reconciliation, provider status, storage and metadata internals, capability-rule demos, lane and ownership assertions, upload/download/profile outcome screens). Do not redraw them; their behavior stays in backend contracts and tests. Real surfaces: AuthGateDialog "Sign in to continue", RequireAuth redirect to /signin, the AccountPopover, inline messages and toasts.
deletedStateVariants: 181 variants named State=<key> (and 47 example frames) on the four 02 · States pages whose source screen no longer exists
wrongNeighbourDeletions: W52 and X23 were removed in place of the intended W53 and X22; both neighbours remain.
